faq.title: How the technology base helps
faq.lead: Answers focused on operation, growth, and commercial reading.

items.title: Why does the website base matter?
items.content: Because it makes it easier to publish a first version, expand content, and understand with first-party data which pages receive more interest.

items.title: Does this change the plan price?
items.content: Plans start from a commercial scope. Special operational costs are reviewed when the project requires more capacity.

items.title: Can I grow by sectors or campaigns?
items.content: Yes. The structure allows specific routes for audiences, services, or campaigns as the business moves forward.

items.title: What data is reviewed first?
items.content: Button clicks, consulted pages, sections with more attention, selected language, and basic commercial interest signals.

final.title: Let us discuss the base your website needs.
final.lead: If your business will grow through pages, sectors, campaigns, or data analysis, it is worth planning from the start.
